answer_1.quote: ...We introduce BIG5-CHAT, a large-scale human‑grounded dialogue responses dataset designed to capture Big Five personality traits within diverse social interactions...
answer_1.outputs: single‑turn dialogue responses conditioned on personality trait levels

answer_2.quote: ...we trained a RoBERTa‑Large classifier with five regression heads ... the classifier achieves an accuracy of 93.8% on the held‑out test set, and we report BFI/IPIP‑NEO scores as well as reasoning benchmark accuracies such as SocialIQA, GSM8K, TruthfulQA, CommonsenseQA, and MMLU...
